name: vista-integrated-information-system
description: Vista Service ERP, CRM, POS, and backup/DR monorepo

scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:fixtures:dev && npm run dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -k -n api,erp-crm,pos,backup -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run start:dev -w @vista/api" "npm run dev -w @vista/erp-crm-web" "npm run dev -w @vista/pos-web" "npm run dev -w @vista/backup-control"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:packages && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run openapi:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.openapi:check: npm run openapi:generate -w @vista/api && npm run client:check -w @vista/contracts
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run openapi:generate -w @vista/api && npm run client:generate -w @vista/contracts
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yml up -d --wait postgres redis minio mailpit && docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yml run --rm minio-init
